title: GUITARS and CADILLACS
lyrics_plain:
Girl you taught me how to hurt real bad and cry myself to sleep.
You showed me how this town  can shatter dreams.
Another lesson bout' a naive fool who came to Babylon.
And found out that the pie don't taste so sweet.
Now It's guitars and cadillacs. And hillbilly music,
And lonley, lonley streets, that I call home.
Yeah, my guitars and cadillacs and hillbilly music.
It's the only thing that keeps me hanging on.
(BREAK)
The're ain't no glammor in this tinseled land. Of lost and wasted lives.
Painful scars is all that's left of me.
I Wanna thank you girl for teaching me, brand new ways to be cruel.
